vaccines.label: Enhanced
vaccines.zh: 加強型流感疫苗（佐劑或高劑量，未指明）

policy.title_zh: 公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 請符合資格民眾儘速接種 及早獲得保護力
policy.title_en: Public flu and COVID vaccinations are popular; eligible people urged to get shots early
policy.summary: The CDC reports flu and COVID vaccinations are up from last year, notes flu cases and severe illness, and urges eligible people, especially high-risk groups, to vaccinate early.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感及新冠公費接種人次較去年增加，並說明流感重症情形，呼籲符合資格民眾及高風險族群儘早接種。
policy.why: CDC links ongoing severe flu activity to unvaccinated older adults and urges pre-holiday vaccination, framing the current severity narrative.
policy.why_zh: 疾管署將持續的流感重症疫情連結至未接種疫苗的長者，並呼籲連假前接種，形塑當前的重症敘事。

policy.title_zh: 「左流右新 護肺顧心」10月1日公費流感及新冠疫苗同步開打
policy.title_en: Left flu, right COVID, protect lungs and heart: public flu and COVID vaccines open together on October 1
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC and Health Minister launched the 2026 public flu and COVID vaccination programme on October 1, urging eligible people to get both. Procurement is 7.05 million flu doses, including enhanced vaccine prioritised for adults 65 and over in long-term care, and the programme opens in two phases.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署與衛福部石崇良部長於10月1日開打115年度公費流感與新冠疫苗，呼籲符合資格民眾同時接種。今年流感疫苗採購約705萬劑，其中加強型流感疫苗優先提供長照及安養機構65歲以上長者，計畫分兩階段開打。
policy.why: Launch event confirmed 7.05 million flu doses procured including enhanced vaccine, the figure now used to judge supply adequacy.
policy.why_zh: 開打記者會確認採購705萬劑流感疫苗（含加強型），此數字現為評估供應是否充足的依據。

policy.title_zh: 2026年度公費流感及新冠疫苗第一階段將於10月1日開打 接種左流右新疫苗還可獲得1350健康幣
policy.title_en: Phase one of 2026 publicly funded flu and COVID vaccines opens October 1; getting both earns 1,350 health coins
policy.summary: The CDC announces phase one of the publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccination programme starts October 1 with 11 eligible groups, procures standard and enhanced flu vaccines, reports ongoing flu and COVID activity with many severe cases among unvaccinated older adults, notes self-pay COVID options, and promotes health coins for vaccination.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布2026年度公費流感及新冠疫苗第一階段10月1日開打，共11類對象，採購標準型與加強型流感疫苗，並說明流感與新冠疫情及重症未接種者比例，同時提及自費新冠接種與健康幣獎勵，呼籲符合資格民眾踴躍接種。
policy.why: Sets the 2026 programme baseline: phase 1 for 11 groups from October 1 with about 6.449 million standard and 170,000 enhanced doses plus health-coin incentives.
policy.why_zh: 確立2026年計畫基準：第一階段10月1日起開放11類對象，約644.9萬劑標準型及17萬劑加強型疫苗，並搭配健康幣獎勵。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠於仍處流行期且流感疫情持續上升 呼籲民眾連假期間加強自主防疫 出現重症危險徵兆儘速就醫
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID-19 still at epidemic levels, flu outpatient visits rising; CDC urges self-protection during holiday and prompt care for warning signs
policy.summary: The CDC reports flu and COVID-19 remain at epidemic levels with rising flu cases and severe illness, and most severe flu patients were unvaccinated this season.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感與新冠仍處流行期，流感病例略升，本季多數流感重症者未接種疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 疾病管制署延長擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象「有類流感症狀，且具下列身分之流感高傳播族群」之適用期限至115年10月31日止，籲請醫師善用公費藥劑，共同防治流感。(疾病管制署致醫界通函第616號)
policy.title_en: CDC extends public flu antiviral drug eligibility for high-transmission groups until October 31, 2026
policy.summary: The CDC extends until October 31, 2026 the expanded eligibility for publicly funded flu antiviral drugs for high-transmission groups with flu-like symptoms, and urges physicians to use them and to promote prevention.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署將公費流感抗病毒藥劑對流感高傳播族群的擴大使用條件延長至115年10月31日，並籲請醫師善用及提醒民眾防護。

policy.title_zh: 目前流感疫情持續上升 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件將延長至今(115)年10月31日止
policy.title_en: Flu cases continue to rise; expanded public flu antiviral drug eligibility extended to October 31 this year
policy.summary: The CDC extends until October 31 the expanded eligibility for publicly funded flu antiviral drugs, notes they are not covered by National Health Insurance, and urges prevention measures.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署延長公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件至10月31日，說明目前未列入健保給付，並提醒民眾做好防護。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠疫情均處流行期且流感疫情持續上升 呼籲民眾落實勤洗手 戴口罩等自我防護措施 並留意重症危險徵兆
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID both in epidemic period; CDC urges hygiene, masks and watching for severe warning signs
policy.summary: The CDC reports rising flu activity and severe cases, notes most severe cases were unvaccinated this season, and urges high-risk groups to take protective measures and seek care early.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感疫情持續上升，本季重症病例多數未接種流感疫苗，並呼籲高風險族群做好防護並及早就醫。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠仍有傳播風險 呼籲民眾出現症狀戴口罩就醫並在家休息 且留意重症危險徵兆
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID still at risk of spread; public urged to wear masks, seek care and rest at home, and watch for warning signs
policy.summary: The CDC reports flu has entered its epidemic period, with severe cases mostly among unvaccinated older adults and people with chronic illness, and urges masks, medical care and attention to warning signs.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感已進入流行期，重症病例多為未接種疫苗的長者與慢性病患者，呼籲配戴口罩就醫並留意危險徵兆。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠疫情持續 呼籲民眾留意個人衛生習慣 出現重症危險徵兆應儘速就醫治療
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID activity continues; public urged to practise hygiene and seek prompt care for severe warning signs
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC reports rising flu outpatient visits and severe cases, most unvaccinated against flu this season, urges vaccination and hygiene, and notes limited COVID vaccine doses available until September 9.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署指出流感門急診就診增加且重症多數未接種本季流感疫苗，呼籲民眾注意衛生並接種疫苗，同時說明新冠疫苗僅供應至9月9日。

policy.title_zh: 因應各級學校即將開學，疾管署呼籲學校與家長落實衛生防護，防範腸病毒、新冠、流感及登革熱疫情
policy.title_en: Ahead of school start, CDC urges schools and parents to enforce hygiene measures against enterovirus, COVID, flu and dengue
policy.summary: The CDC urges schools and parents to enforce hygiene measures, reports flu and COVID activity with unvaccinated shares, and urges eligible people to get COVID vaccines before supplies end.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署呼籲學校與家長落實衛生防護，並通報流感與新冠疫情，提醒符合資格者儘速接種新冠疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 115年秋冬公費首度導入加強型流感及新世代新冠疫苗 疫苗株全更新精準防護 疾管署呼籲流感新冠同時打「左流右新 護肺顧心」
policy.title_en: Enhanced flu and new-generation COVID vaccines enter public programme for autumn-winter 2026; CDC urges same-day flu and COVID vaccination
policy.summary: The CDC announces 7.05 million public flu doses including enhanced flu vaccines, updated strains, eligibility changes, and urges co-administration of flu and COVID vaccines, noting the health coin reward applies to both public and self-paid doses.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布2026年秋冬公費流感疫苗採購705萬劑，含加強型流感疫苗，並更新疫苗株與接種對象，呼籲流感與新冠疫苗同時接種；健康幣對公費與自費接種皆適用。

policy.title_zh: 疾管署自今年8月24日至9月30日擴大公費藥劑使用對象(疾病管制署致醫界通函第613號)
policy.title_en: CDC expands public flu antiviral drug use from Aug 24 to Sep 30 (CDC letter No. 613 to medical community)
policy.summary: The CDC letter tells clinicians that public flu antiviral eligibility is expanded from August 24 to September 30 to seven high-transmission groups, as flu visits rise slightly.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署致醫界通函指出，因類流感門急診微幅上升，8月24日至9月30日公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大至7類高傳播族群。

policy.title_zh: 國內外近期流感疫情緩升，疾管署自今年8月24日起至9月30日擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用條件
policy.title_en: Flu activity rises slightly; CDC expands public antiviral drug eligibility from Aug 24
policy.summary: The CDC reports a slight rise in flu activity and severe cases, notes that 72% of severe cases this season were unvaccinated, and announces expanded public antiviral eligibility from August 24 to September 30.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感略為回升，本季重症病例中72%未接種流感疫苗，並宣布8月24日至9月30日擴大公費抗病毒藥劑對象。

policy.title_zh: 國內流感疫情雖尚未進入流行期，但已有緩升趨勢，以A型流感為主
policy.title_en: Domestic flu not yet in epidemic but rising, mainly influenza A
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC reports flu activity rising since early July, mainly influenza A, with severe cases and deaths concentrated among older adults and people who were unvaccinated this season.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示國內流感疫情自7月起緩升，以A型為主，重症與死亡個案多為65歲以上長者，且多數未接種本季流感疫苗。

entries.headline: Weekly flu toll hits five-year high: 219 severe cases, 44 deaths
entries.why: Severity now drives the vaccination appeals from officials and doctors, and reports say the epidemic may not ease until November. This shapes the public programme (公費) narrative and private demand alike.
entries.headline_zh: 單週流感重症創五年新高：219例重症、44例死亡
entries.why_zh: 疫情嚴重程度成為官員與醫師呼籲接種的主要訴求，報導指出疫情可能要到11月才會趨緩。這同時影響公費計畫的論述與自費需求。

entries.headline: 1.32 million public flu doses in six days; Lo Yi-chun voices supply worry
entries.why: Uptake ran about 24% above last year and passed 1.91 million doses in eight days, and coverage links part of this to health coins. A senior figure publicly questioning supply makes 公費 allocation and replenishment a live issue ahead of the second stage.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗六天接種132萬劑；羅一鈞表達供應疑慮
entries.why_zh: 接種量較去年高約24%，八天內突破191萬劑，報導將部分成長歸因於健康幣。高層人士公開質疑供應量，使公費疫苗的分配與補貨成為第二階段開打前的焦點議題。

entries.headline: Doctors urge adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines for older high-risk patients
entries.why: Clinicians frame enhanced vaccines around chronic disease risk, and one outlet reports a 143% higher death risk for kidney, heart and diabetes patients. Funding is mostly not stated in these reports. Separately, a clinic post makes comparative efficacy claims that raise advertising-rule exposure.
entries.headline_zh: 醫師呼籲高風險長者接種佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗
entries.why_zh: 臨床醫師以慢性病風險為切入點倡議加強型疫苗，有媒體報導腎臟病、心臟病及糖尿病患者死亡風險高出143%。這些報導多未說明經費來源。另外，一則診所貼文提出療效比較宣稱，可能涉及廣告法規風險。

entries.headline: Self-pay flu stock patchy: Kaohsiung clinics say November, Lienchiang limits bookings
entries.why: These are self-pay (自費) signals. Users report clinics without self-pay stock until November, and Lienchiang County opened limited advance booking. Separately, posts say 公費 clinics stock a single brand (Medigen).
entries.headline_zh: 自費流感疫苗供貨不均：高雄診所稱11月到貨，連江縣限量預約
entries.why_zh: 以上為自費市場訊號。網友反映有診所自費疫苗要到11月才有貨，連江縣則開放限量預約。另有貼文指出公費診所僅提供單一廠牌（高端）。

entries.headline: Parents confused over new two-dose rule for children under three
entries.why: Coverage of the dosing change for 6 months to 3 years coincides with parents reporting conflicting clinic answers about catch-up doses and the subsidy ending in March. Other posts report fever after nasal spray vaccine. This mainly touches the 公費 programme.
entries.headline_zh: 三歲以下幼兒接種兩劑新規定，家長感到困惑
entries.why_zh: 6個月至3歲幼兒接種劑次調整的報導出現之際，家長反映各診所對補接種及3月補助截止的說法不一。另有貼文提到接種鼻噴疫苗後發燒。此議題主要涉及公費計畫。

entries.headline: RSV-linked cluster of 16 infants at Changhua postpartum care home
entries.why: RSV conversation rose from 3 to 16 items week on week. Infant-cluster coverage and posts on maternal RSV evidence put infant protection on the agenda, though funding is not stated.
entries.headline_zh: 彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚感染，疑與RSV有關
entries.why_zh: RSV相關討論由3則增至16則（週比較）。嬰兒群聚事件報導及孕婦RSV疫苗實證的貼文，使嬰兒保護成為討論議題，惟經費來源未說明。

watch.text: Second stage of the public flu programme opens. Watch whether supply concerns raised during the first-week surge resurface in allocation decisions.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打。觀察首週接種潮期間浮現的供應疑慮是否再度影響分配決策。

watch.text: Reports say flu may not exit the epidemic period until November at the earliest. Watch weekly severe-case and death counts against the 219/44 high.
watch.text_zh: 報導指出流感最快要到11月才會脫離流行期。持續對照219例重症／44例死亡的高峰，追蹤每週重症與死亡數。

watch.text: Kaohsiung clinics told users self-pay flu stock arrives in November. Track whether self-pay availability normalises or stock-out posts spread.
watch.text_zh: 高雄診所告知網友自費流感疫苗11月到貨。追蹤自費疫苗供應是否恢復正常，或缺貨貼文是否擴散。

qa.q: Is public-programme (公費) flu vaccine supply at risk before the second stage opens on 2026-11-02?
qa.a: Uptake is running well ahead of last year: 1.32 million doses in six days and more than 1.91 million in eight, with Kaohsiung reporting first-week uptake over 20% higher. Lo Yi-chun has publicly worried that supply may not be enough. The Taiwan CDC's notices urge early vaccination but do not address any shortfall, so allocation and replenishment are an open question.
qa.q_zh: 公費流感疫苗供應是否可能在2026-11-02第二階段開打前出現缺口？
qa.a_zh: 今年接種進度明顯超前去年：六天內接種132萬劑，八天內逾191萬劑；高雄市亦表示首週接種量較去年增加逾20%。羅一鈞已公開表達對疫苗供應可能不足的擔憂。疾管署公告呼籲民眾及早接種，但未回應任何短缺問題，因此疫苗配送與補貨狀況仍屬未知。

qa.q: What is the conversation around enhanced (adjuvanted / high-dose) flu vaccines this week?
qa.a: Several outlets carry doctors urging older high-risk and chronically ill patients to choose adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines, citing a reported 143% higher death risk for kidney, heart and diabetes patients; most of these reports do not state funding. A clinic post on Threads separately claims 20-30% better protection and 12-month coverage for an adjuvanted vaccine, which is a promotional claim that raises advertising-rule exposure.
qa.q_zh: 本週關於加強型（含佐劑／高劑量）流感疫苗的討論為何？
qa.a_zh: 多家媒體報導醫師呼籲高齡高風險族群及慢性病患者選擇含佐劑或高劑量疫苗，並引述報導指出腎臟病、心臟病及糖尿病患者死亡風險高出143%；這些報導多數未說明費用由誰支付。另有一則診所Threads貼文宣稱某含佐劑疫苗保護力提升20-30%、保護期達12個月，此屬宣傳性說法，有觸及廣告法規的風險。

qa.q: What are we seeing in the self-pay (自費) market?
qa.a: Social signals are thin but point to patchy stock: a Kaohsiung user reports two clinics said self-pay flu vaccine will not arrive until November. One TV report mentions self-paid vaccination, but the items include no price or demand data. Posts also say several 公費 clinics stock only the Medigen brand, which may push brand-conscious people towards self-pay where it is available.
qa.q_zh: 自費市場目前有哪些動向？
qa.a_zh: 社群訊號有限，但顯示庫存分布不均：一名高雄網友表示，兩家診所告知自費流感疫苗要到11月才會到貨。一則電視報導提及自費接種，但相關內容未包含價格或需求數據。另有貼文指出，數家公費診所僅提供高端廠牌，可能促使重視廠牌的民眾轉向有供貨的自費接種。

narratives.title: Infant RSV: care-home cluster and maternal vaccination
narratives.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV：護理之家群聚與孕婦接種

narratives.para_zh: 彰化產後護理之家傳出16名嬰兒疑似RSV群聚，加上孕婦RSV疫苗實證的貼文，使嬰兒RSV討論雖少但持續增加。

voices.text: A person reports that two Kaohsiung clinics said self-paid flu vaccine will not be available until November.
voices.text_zh: 有人反映，高雄兩家診所表示自費流感疫苗要到11月才會供應。

voices.text: A parent says several mothers reported fever after nasal spray flu vaccine and asks whether to choose an injection for their child instead.
voices.text_zh: 有家長表示，多位母親反映接種鼻噴式流感疫苗後出現發燒，因此詢問是否應為孩子改選注射型疫苗。

voices.text: A clinic promotes an adjuvanted flu vaccine, claiming 20 to 30 percent better protection and 12 months of coverage, and invites people to get it at its clinic.
voices.text_zh: 一家診所宣傳含佐劑流感疫苗，聲稱保護力提升20至30%、可維持12個月，並邀請民眾至診所接種。

voices.text: A parent describes two children getting the nasal flu vaccine, one developing fever about 36 hours later that lasted roughly two days before resolving, and says they recovered.
voices.text_zh: 一位家長描述兩名孩子接種鼻噴式流感疫苗，其中一人約在三十六小時後發燒，持續約兩天後退燒，並表示孩子已康復。

voices.text: A post claims that flu, measles, varicella, hepatitis B and HPV vaccines contain or use viruses and says a local office's call for seniors to get vaccinated endangers them.
voices.text_zh: 一則貼文宣稱流感、麻疹、水痘、B型肝炎與HPV疫苗含有或使用病毒，並認為地方機關呼籲長者接種會危害其健康。

voices.text: A post summarises a European pooled real-world study linking prenatal RSV vaccination to about 74% relative risk reduction in infant RSV hospitalisation, and notes the figure is relative and recommendations vary by country.
voices.text_zh: 一篇貼文整理歐洲多國合併真實世界研究，指出產前接種RSV疫苗可使嬰兒RSV住院相對風險降低約74%，並提醒此數字為相對值，且各國建議不同。
